name: Data.v_N_eq_exp_neg_one
summary: The valuation of N(D) in E(D)_w is its w-adic valuation, which is exp(−1) because N(D) is prime, lies in w and is prime to N₁(D)·d(P).

steps.claim: The valuation of N(D) in E(D)_w equals the w-adic valuation of the integer N(D) (`v_algebraMap_eq_intValuation`), and that is exp(−1) by `Parameters.intValuation_p` for the prime p = N(D) (instance Fact (N(D) prime)), the place w ∋ N(D) (h) and N(D) ∤ N₁(D)·d(P), which holds because N(D) ≡ 1 mod N₁(D)·d(P) (`Data.N_modEq_one`, then `Parameters.not_dvd_N₁_mul_d_of_modEq_one`).
